cds.title: California State University, Los Angeles Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; fall 2025 first-year class)

ipeds.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator: fall 2024 admissions summary and enrollment, student-to-faculty ratio

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set, fall 2025 first-year class; totals are the residency-table sums (in-state 33,359 + out-of-state 2,539 + international 796 applicants; 31,008 + 1,744 + 457 admits; 2,905 + 0 + 15 enrolled). The gender lines add to slightly lower totals (35,898 applicants, 32,752 admits, 2,938 enrolled), an inconsistency in the Common Data Set. International applicants were admitted at about 57% versus about 91% overall. College Navigator shows fall 2024: 32,723 applicants, 91% admitted. The GPA ranges and the 3.21 average are for all enrolled first-year students. SAT/ACT are not used in admission (per the Common Data Set), so no test score ranges are reported. Undergraduate enrollment is the College Navigator fall 2024 headcount (19,586); the Common Data Set undergraduate total (22,077) does not reconcile with its own degree-seeking lines, so that figure is not used. International undergraduates number 733 (degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates).

cds_test_policy.notes: The 2025-2026 Common Data Set marks SAT/ACT as not used in admission decisions.

cost.notes: In the Common Data Set, 8 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received the college's own scholarship or grant aid (need-based or non-need-based, the Common Data Set does not say which), average $9,042, total $72,335. The Common Data Set tuition figures are not used; costs come from Cal State LA's fee and cost-of-attendance pages
